interpretation: Both tracks have successful legal-action feasibility evidence.
All six goal-only Baseline Episodes failed. Astra ST showed some partial progress but never held more than one original sample in its observed trajectory; this was not a near-complete return failure.
Success-level discrimination is not established; the VM round also has a zero-cargo floor for all three models.
No infrastructure errors were reported in these six Episodes. Sol ST's final request was cancelled by the deadline, not evidence of a provider outage.
All six goal-only Episodes had zero deaths. The separately observed roof-respawn behavior did not cause these failures.
Hinted success and static-layout references do not establish that all task-relevant information is readily discoverable under the production prompt.
One Episode per model and prompt condition is developmental evidence, not a statistically reliable model ranking.
